storage_and_wrapped_reserves.interpretation: The exchange total includes cold storage, omnibus custody and wrapped-asset backing reserves. It is not tradable float or customer-deposit inventory.

methodology_and_limitations: The publisher says it reads each tracked wallet once daily at about 08:00 UTC from rippled account_info on the latest validated ledger.
If a wallet read fails, its last good balance is retained until the next successful run; per-wallet freshness is not exposed in the page.
Exchange attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels only.
Same-wallet changes remove wallets first tracked after the start of the window; an exchange whose wallet set changes can be excluded.
The publisher stores per-exchange daily totals and wallet counts, not per-wallet history; same-wallet changes are available only for windows ending at the latest snapshot.
An exchange moving XRP to an untracked wallet can appear as an outflow until that wallet is labeled.
OKX and Korbit main wallets are not in the tracked set; Coins.ph coverage is also incomplete.
A September 29 audit identified about 323M XRP in XRPSCAN-labeled wallets at roughly 36 exchanges outside the tracked list.
Newly labeled wallets are added on the next daily run; the raw total can jump from coverage changes rather than flows.
ETF custody wallets without public exchange labels are not included.
